hook.name: YinYangHook
hook.description: A twin-token hook for the YinYang project that bootstraps ETH/Yin and ETH/Yang pools on first liquidity add, then on each swap mints or burns token "piece" state based on the buy/sell direction. Takes a per-swap skim fee (up to 20% sniper tax during the first 10 seconds after pool launch, then a configurable base rate) forwarded to a owner-controlled destination via `afterSwapReturnsDelta`.
